versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the salary-tax-calculator skill for personal income tax calculation and optimization.
- Supports monthly salary tax, annual bonus optimization, labor remuneration tax, itemized deductions inquiry, and annual tax return estimation.
- Provides two-way tax (pre-tax/post-tax) conversion.
- Includes detailed parameter collection and calculation process for different income types.
- Summarizes special deduction criteria and quick reference tables.
- Outputs result breakdowns and optimization suggestions; all outcomes are for reference only.
